ui.actions.intro: Coming from the release sync tool. Nothing runs without your “go” and the confirmation; the QA comment asks for a new “go” after the sync.
ui.actions.title: Release actions
ui.actions.title.conflict: Conflict on #{issue} when syncing with main
ui.actions.what.conflictPush: Pushes the branch with the main merge already resolved and verified in the local worktree: fast-forward, no force, visible to the team. Before sending, the branch is fetched again and the push is refused if it changed.
ui.actions.what.qaComment.edit: Edits the QA pipelines comment in place (note {noteId}), visible to the team on the issue.
ui.actions.what.qaComment.post: Posts the tool's sync comment on the issue, visible to the team.
ui.actions.what.releaseGit: One step of a release, run in the repository's own checkout by its release script or by plain git. A push is plain, never forced, and only goes out with this yes; what is sent is shown by "See the push".
ui.actions.what.runPush: Pushes the run's branch from its worktree: plain push, no force, visible to the team. What is pushed is the branch as it is when you confirm.
ui.actions.what.sync.noRetest: Merges main into {branches} and pushes (fast-forward, no force-push). The release did not touch files in the {cr}: no retest.
ui.actions.what.sync.retest: Merges main into {branches} and pushes (fast-forward, no force-push). The release touched files in the {cr}: QA needs to retest.
ui.ata.decisions.empty: No decisions in this ceremony. The minutes are saved anyway, with the transcript.
ui.ata.decisions.hint: Each one goes to its home: the Plan log, a card note or just the minutes.
ui.ata.decisions.hint.off-sdd: Each one goes to its home: the decision log, a card note or just the minutes.

ui.retro.heading: Weekly retro
ui.retro.improvements.hint: IMPROVEMENTS.md belongs to the team: copy the entry and take it through Claude Code on a docs/<slug> branch.

ui.retro.improvements.title: Proposed improvements
ui.retro.intro: The retro gathers the ceremonies, decisions, release actions, gate quizzes and {vcsName} changes from the last {retroDays} days. The agent leads; the improvements come out in the IMPROVEMENTS.md format for you to take through Claude Code.
ui.retro.introPlain: The retro gathers the ceremonies, the decisions and the {vcsName} changes from the last {retroDays} days. The agent leads and proposes improvements.
